original_objective: NEEWA, build a project-status application. Research the approach, define the requirements, have the council challenge the design, implement it, test it, correct defects and give me a release candidate.

requirements.text: Accept a JSON file describing project statuses.
Print a human-readable status report including name and health.
Reject malformed JSON with a non-zero exit code.
Automated tests cover happy path and malformed input.
Do not access employer trees or unrestricted filesystem paths.
